Script executed: ```bash #!/bin/bash # Check whether messageRows.test.tsx is referenced by any CI test script or vitest config. rg -n 'messageRows\.test' package.json src/dashboard/frontend/package.json .github 2>/dev/null fd -t f 'vitest.config.*' . --exec rg -n 'include|exclude' {} ``` Repository: eltmon/overdeck Length of output: 2333 --- Script executed: ```bash #!/bin/bash set -u printf '%s\n' '--- package scripts ---' python3 - <<'PY' import json from pathlib import Path for name in ('package.json', 'src/dashboard/frontend/package.json'): p = Path(name) print(f'[{name}]') if not p.exists(): print('missing') continue data = json.loads(p.read_text()) for k, v in data.get('scripts', {}).items(): if 'frontend' in k.lower() or 'test' in k.lower() or 'vitest' in k.lower(): print(f'{k}: {v}') PY printf '%s\n' '--- target test file ---' if [ -f src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/messagesTimeline/messageRows.test.tsx ]; then nl -ba src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/messagesTimeline/messageRows.test.tsx | sed -n '1,240p' else printf '%s\n' 'target file missing' fi printf '%s\n' '--- exact references and CI commands ---' rg -n -F --glob '!**/node_modules/**' --glob '!**/dist/**' -e 'test:frontend-subset' -e 'messageRows.test' -e 'vitest' .github package.json src/dashboard/frontend/package.json 2>/dev/null || test "$?" -eq 1 printf '%s\n' '--- frontend vitest config files ---' fd -t f 'vitest.config.*' src/dashboard/frontend . --exclude node_modules --exclude dist 2>/dev/null | sort -u ``` Repository: eltmon/overdeck Length of output: 30607 --- Script executed: ```bash #!/bin/bash set -u printf '%s\n' '--- CI frontend and root test commands ---' nl -ba .github/workflows/ci.yml | sed -n '195,252p' printf '%s\n' '--- root Vitest config ---' nl -ba vitest.config.ts | sed -n '45,65p' printf '%s\n' '--- frontend Vitest config ---' nl -ba src/dashboard/frontend/vitest.config.ts | sed -n '1,90p' ``` Repository: eltmon/overdeck Length of output: 7508 ---
**Register `messageRows.test.tsx` in `test:frontend-subset`.** The frontend CI step runs the explicit subset, and the root Vitest suite excludes `src/dashboard/frontend/**`. Because this test file is not in the subset list, its PAN-4642 cite-row and `data-cited` tests do not run in CI.
Suggested fix
```diff + src/components/chat/messagesTimeline/messageRows.test.tsx ```

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Gate `citationsEnabled` on the composer actually being mounted.** `citationsEnabled={!hideComposer}` only checks the prop. `ConversationView` renders `ComposerFooter` (which holds `CitationChips`) only in the last branch of the chain at lines 1482–1518. The composer is not mounted when any of these is true: - `conversation.clearedToConvId` is set. - `isForking` is true. - `onResume` is set. This covers every ended conversation that shows the resume bar. - `conversation.origin === 'vault'`. In that case `ComposerFooter` returns `VaultReadOnlyNotice`. In those states the timeline still shows **Cite**. The user can save a citation. The quote is highlighted and stored in `localStorage`. No chip appears, so the user cannot see, edit, remove or send the citation until a composer mounts. Mirror the composer condition. This keeps the change to one line, as the file-size cap requires.
Proposed fix
```diff --- "a/src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/ConversationPanel.tsx" +++ "b/src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/ConversationPanel.tsx" @@ -1468,7 +1468,7 @@ targetMessageNonce={targetMessageNonce} onTargetMessageHandled={onTargetMessageHandled} bookmarksEnabled - citationsEnabled={!hideComposer} + citationsEnabled={!hideComposer && !onResume && !isForking && !conversation.clearedToConvId && conversation.origin !== 'vault'} history={olderHistory} onLoadOlder={olderHistory.loadOlder} onLoadOlderUntil={olderHistory.loadOlderUntil} ```
Committable suggestion
> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion citationsEnabled={!hideComposer && !onResume && !isForking && !conversation.clearedToConvId && conversation.origin !== 'vault'} ```
